title: In Vivo Smooth Muscle Cell-Specific CRISPRi Perturb-seq in Atherosclerosis Protocol
author: João Pinho Monteiro
materials: Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4
Reagents Tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS T5648-1G) Sunflower seed oil (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS S5007-259ML) 100% Ethanol Oral gavage needles (appropriate gauge/length for adult mice) + syringes

Endpoint : - Sacrifice after 9 weeks of HFD . Reagents: - Liberase TM medium Thermolysin (Roche #05401127001) - Reconstituted in HBSS to 26 units/mL. - After reconstitution, divide into single-use aliquots, as performance degrades significantly withfreeze-thaw. - Elastase (Worthington #LS002279), stock solution has variable concentration - HBSS, calcium, magnesium, no phenol red (Gibco # 14025092) - PBS Equipment: - Fine dissection scissors (e.g. FST 14058-09) - 5mL Round Bottom Polystyrene FACS Tubes w/ 35um Strainer Cap (Falcon # 352235). - Pre-cooled centrifuge at 4°C w/ swing bucket

steps.title: Prepare 20 mg/mL Tamoxifen solution
steps.instruction: Make a 9:1 sunflower oil to ethanol vehicle (e.g., 900 µL oil + 100 µL ethanol), weigh 20 mg tamoxifen, add 1 mL of the vehicle, dissolve overnight at 37 °C, then store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Administer tamoxifen induction regimen
steps.instruction: At 7–8 weeks of age give two oral gavage doses of the 20 mg/mL tamoxifen solution at ~0.2 mg per gram body weight, spaced 72–96 h apart (e.g., a 30 g mouse receives 6 mg → 0.3 mL or 300 µL). Start a Western high‑fat diet one week after the first gavage and maintain the diet for a total of 9 weeks.

steps.title: Inject AAV retro‑orbitally
steps.instruction: At week 4 of the Western HFD, inject each mouse retro‑orbitally with AAV‑PR at a concentration of 1 × 10¹² vg/mL, delivering 100 µL per mouse; continue the HFD for an additional 5 weeks (total 9 weeks).

steps.title: Prepare AAV virus dilution
steps.instruction: Thaw the AAV stock on ice; if not using the whole vial, aliquot the remainder and refreeze on dry ice, storing at –80 °C. Dilute the virus in sterile DPBS to achieve 1 × 10¹² vg/mL in a final volume of 100 µL per mouse, load into a 31 G insulin syringe, and minimize bubbles.

steps.title: Perform retro‑orbital injection
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in an induction chamber, start isoflurane at 3–4 % with a flow of 0.8–1.0 L/min, and wait until breathing slows to ~1 breath/s. Maintain anesthesia at 1–2 % via nose cone. Position the mouse on its side, gently press the upper and lower eyelids to protrude the globe, and apply a drop of 0.5 % proparacaine HCl; dab excess with sterile gauze. Using a 1 mL syringe (or smaller) with a 27–30 G, ½″ needle, insert at a 30–45° angle, bevel down, lateral to the medial canthus, through the conjunctival membrane, advance to the bony orbit (do not penetrate), retract slightly, and inject 100 µL slowly. Remove the needle, close the eyelids, apply mild pressure with gauze, then allow the mouse to recover on a heated pad, monitoring every 15 min until ambulatory.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme solution for aorta digestion
steps.instruction: On ice, prepare a 1 mL enzyme mix containing Liberase TM (26 U/mL) 77 µL, Elastase (125 U/mL) 16 µL, and HBSS 907 µL to give final working concentrations of 2 U/mL Liberase and 2 U/mL Elastase. Keep the mixture on ice while harvesting the aorta.

steps.title: Perfuse mouse and harvest aorta
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse with isoflurane (3–4 %, 0.8–1.0 L/min) to surgical depth, make a midline skin incision over abdomen and thorax, open the cavities, puncture the diaphragm, and perform a thoracotomy. Incise the right atrium for exsanguination, insert a 25–27 G needle into the left ventricle or ascending aorta, and perfuse ~10 mL sterile PBS until tissues blanch and the effluent runs clear. Harvest the aortic root, open it longitudinally, and wash three times with PBS in a 12‑well dish kept on ice.

steps.title: Digest aortic tissue and obtain single cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the aortic root to a 12‑well dish containing 1 mL of the enzyme mixture and incubate at 37 °C for 30–45 min (adjust to 45 min for older or calcified tissue, e.g., ApoE‑null 16‑wk HFD). Mince with scissors on ice for ≤5 min until mostly dissolved, then pipet up/down 20–30 times. Verify single‑cell suspension under a microscope; if clumps remain, incubate an additional 10–15 min (avoid longer incubations). Transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min, carefully remove supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 300 µL HBSS (adjust volume if needed). Immediately before FACS, pass the cells through a 35 µm strainer (coating collection tubes with 10 % BSA may improve viability).

steps.title: Sort tdT+ and GFP+ cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Using flow cytometry, isolate the dual‑positive tdTomato⁺ (lineage‑traced SMC‑derived) and GFP⁺ (AAV‑transduced) cell population.

steps.title: Prepare 10x Genomics single‑cell library
steps.instruction: Pool dual‑positive cells from 3–5 mice (aiming for >8,000 cells per run) and follow the standard 10x Genomics Chromium GEM‑X Single Cell 3’ v4 workflow (CG000731) and Feature Barcoding guide (CG000389), specifically Step 2.3C followed by Step 4 for guide‑library construction, using the listed reagents (Chromium GEM‑X Kit v4, Gel Bead v4, Chip Kit v4, Dual Index Kits, 3’ Feature Barcode Kit).
